intro: Hey! I'm Ashwin Kumar, a MERN stack developer based in Pune, India. I love building web apps that are functional, fun, and intuitive. I'm especially drawn to the frontend—bringing designs to life and making interfaces smooth and engaging.
background: I'm a Computer Engineer with over a year of experience working on both professional projects and personal passion builds. Along the way, I've picked up UI/UX basics and enough Figma to quickly prototype ideas. I've also dabbled in Game Development and 3D modeling with Blender. Always curious, I'm constantly exploring new tools and sharpening my craft.

experience.description: Developing and maintaining AI-driven web applications. Leading development efforts across frontend and backend systems while mentoring junior team members.
Developed user-facing interfaces for multiple mobile and web applications. Focused on code optimization and backend integration.
Participated in full-cycle project development from initial coding to production deployment. Led UI redesign initiatives.

lifeOutsideWork: Outside of coding, you'll probably find me lost in music, a good movie, or a game. I also love being behind the camera—capturing stories through photos and frames. Anything creative with an artistic edge tends to pull me in.
